name: @tradrl/firm-memory
description: Firm-memory contracts (Work Order T034): the FirmKnowledgeRecord (a promoted, deduplicated learning unit with provenance refs back to its supporting post-mortems/outcomes/experiments, confidence, validity window and content address), the closed knowledge-kind vocabulary, the two append-only chain-verified logs (the knowledge chain + the contradiction register — T030/T031's fold law, mirrored: rewriting or hiding a knowledge entry is a typed error), the promotion policy shapes (evidence count, non-contradiction, window stability), and the point-in-time query contracts (ask the brain only what was knowable at instant T — L4).
